level_4.source_name: Pew Research Center, Americans and AI 2026 (fieldwork 2026-02-17〜23, n = 5,119 U.S. adults)
level_4.note: 49% of U.S. adults use AI chatbots; per-tool shares ChatGPT 44 / Gemini 24 / Copilot 17 / Meta AI 14 / Grok 8 / Claude 6 / Character.ai 3 sum to 116%. rate = 1 − 49/116 = 0.58: the share of tool-user counts that are the same people. 'Ever use', U.S. only — a proxy for 30-day global overlap until a better survey is found.
